title: erythranthe stolonifera
intro: Erythranthe stolonifera, commonly known as Western Buttercup, is a flowering plant native to North America. The health benefits of Western Buttercup include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Western Buttercup on human health.
